body:
Based in New York, Rogowski will focus on originating, structuring, underwriting and executing direct private lending transactions across the food, beverage and agribusiness industries.

He will work alongside Jonathan Logan, who leads deal origination for Proterra Credit, and the firm’s broader investment team to develop relationships with financial sponsors, corporations and family-owned businesses seeking financing solutions.

The appointment brings more than 20 years of leveraged finance and capital markets experience to Proterra, including extensive work in the food and agribusiness sectors.

Rogowski joins the firm after spending more than 14 years at Rabobank, where he advanced from vice president to managing director.

During his tenure, he played a significant role in developing Rabobank’s U.S. leveraged finance platform, helping expand its loan syndication and capital markets capabilities.

His responsibilities included developing relationships with private equity sponsors and supporting financing transactions involving companies in the food and agricultural industries.

Rogowski also contributed to the bank’s efforts to strengthen its presence in the U.S. leveraged lending market, working with businesses and financial sponsors on financing structures and capital markets transactions.

Earlier in his career, he held leveraged finance and credit positions at several financial institutions, building experience in underwriting, transaction execution and corporate lending.

His background includes structuring financing arrangements, evaluating credit opportunities and working with borrowers across different stages of business development.

At Proterra, Rogowski will apply that experience to support the firm’s private credit investment strategy, with an emphasis on identifying lending opportunities across the food value chain.

“We’re thrilled to welcome Eric to Proterra. He will greatly enhance our East Coast coverage,” said **Rich Gammill**, managing partner at Proterra Investment Partners.

“Eric (‘Rogo’) is known and respected for his deep sector expertise and strong track record of success. He will be a great addition to our growing Credit team.”

The appointment supports Proterra’s efforts to expand its credit origination network and strengthen relationships with borrowers and financial intermediaries in key U.S. markets.

Proterra Credit focuses on private lending opportunities involving businesses operating across the food, beverage and agribusiness sectors.

These industries encompass companies involved in agricultural production, food processing, manufacturing, distribution and other activities throughout the global food supply chain.

Businesses operating in these markets often require financing for acquisitions, expansion initiatives, working capital and other strategic objectives.

Private credit providers can offer financing structures tailored to borrowers’ operating characteristics, capital requirements and business plans.

Proterra’s investment strategy emphasizes sector specialization, allowing its credit team to evaluate lending opportunities using its experience in food and agriculture markets.

Rogowski’s appointment is intended to strengthen the firm’s ability to identify transactions, evaluate borrower requirements and structure financing arrangements for companies within those sectors.

His New York location will also support Proterra’s coverage of financial sponsors, corporate borrowers and family-owned businesses across the East Coast.

The role includes developing new relationships and expanding existing connections within the financial sponsor and corporate finance communities.

By working with Logan and the broader Proterra Credit team, Rogowski will contribute to the firm’s deal sourcing, underwriting and transaction execution activities.

“Food and beverage companies benefit from working with lenders who understand the dynamics of their businesses and can provide flexible capital solutions,” Rogowski said.

“Proterra has built a differentiated platform with sector expertise, and I’m excited to join the team and help build on that foundation.”

Proterra Investment Partners operates as an alternative asset manager focused on private equity and private credit investments throughout the global food value chain.

The firm invests across six core business areas: Credit, Farmland, Growth Equity, Proterra Asia, Sustainable Agriculture and Real Estate.

Its investment activities span businesses and assets associated with agricultural production, food-related industries and supporting infrastructure.

The firm’s strategy combines investment management capabilities with industry knowledge across different segments of the food economy.

Within that structure, Proterra Credit provides a platform for pursuing direct lending opportunities involving food, beverage and agribusiness companies.

The addition of Rogowski strengthens the platform’s origination capabilities and provides additional senior-level expertise in leveraged finance and capital markets.

His experience at Rabobank is particularly relevant to Proterra’s sector focus, given his involvement in financing transactions and developing sponsor relationships within the food and agribusiness industries.

The appointment also expands the firm’s senior investment coverage in New York, complementing its existing operations and broader global investment activities.

Headquartered in Minneapolis, Proterra employs 76 professionals across five offices in Minneapolis, New York, Fayetteville, Shanghai and Singapore.

The firm’s international presence supports investment activities across North America and Asia, including opportunities involving agricultural assets, food businesses and related industries.

With Rogowski joining as managing director, Proterra is adding experienced credit origination and transaction execution leadership as it continues developing its private lending platform.

The appointment reflects the firm’s strategy of expanding its network of borrower and sponsor relationships while maintaining a specialized investment focus on the global food value chain.

Rogowski will play a role in sourcing new transactions, structuring credit investments and supporting the continued growth of Proterra Credit’s direct lending activities.
